blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The NBA’s November 16 (November 17 in the US) slate featured the Knicks, Timberwolves, Pistons, Jazz and Lakers picked up victories Tuesday, with Los Angeles extending its winning streak to nine games. Utah snapped a 10-game losing streak, while Detroit ended San Antonio’s 12-game run. New York Knicks beat Toronto Raptors, 111-102 Jalen Brunson scored 31 points, including a tiebreaking four-point play with 1:25 remaining. Karl-Anthony Towns had 16 points and 16 rebounds, while Mikal Bridges scored 17 and OG Anunoby added 16.
